explicitExclusions.reason: Documentation and examples were used as product context but were not runtime security-review worklist rows.
Unit tests were executed as verification; test source was not treated as shipped runtime attack surface.
Dependency resolution was covered through the lockfile and production advisory audit rather than full-file dependency source review.
Generated build and coverage output was excluded from semantic source review.

surfaces.label: Workspace and executable configuration
surfaces.notes: Workspace-local YAML is selected ahead of shared configuration and can choose the executable and arguments reached by an ordinary file-backed request.
surfaces.riskArea: Untrusted configuration promoted to child-process policy

surfaces.label: Configuration reload
surfaces.notes: A narrow race was reproduced, but the executable was already authorized and running, status exposes the stale condition, and shutdown eventually stops it.

surfaces.label: File-backed MCP paths
surfaces.notes: An outside-workspace excerpt is possible, but no lower-privileged recipient or independent exfiltration principal was established in the local single-user model.

surfaces.label: Rename workspace edits
surfaces.notes: Targets are canonicalized under the real workspace, symlink escape and invalid edits are rejected, and content is staged before replacement. Multi-file atomicity remains reliability hardening.

surfaces.label: LSP protocol and diagnostics
surfaces.notes: An ordinary TypeScript server produced 10,000 retained diagnostics and an 868,893-character response from hostile workspace content.

surfaces.label: Preload files
surfaces.notes: Escaping preload paths add no capability beyond the executable authority already granted to the same profile; selection remains one file per entry.

surfaces.label: Logs and resources
surfaces.notes: Window messages and generic logs are bounded; diagnostics independently lack storage and response bounds.

surfaces.label: Session lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Retained documents and reload state are local lifecycle issues; the initialize timeout lacks a lower-authority security trigger.

surfaces.label: YAML parsing
surfaces.notes: Safe parsing and strict Zod transforms prevent executable YAML tags, and no dynamic-property execution sink was found.

surfaces.label: Plugin package metadata
surfaces.notes: Manifests consistently invoke the intended package. The explicit latest-tag policy remains ecosystem hardening rather than a repository substitution flaw.
surfaces.riskArea: Mutable package selection and manifest drift

surfaces.label: Installation skills
surfaces.notes: Shipped mirrors are byte-identical and point to official ecosystem packages or releases with executable verification guidance.

surfaces.label: CI and release
surfaces.notes: Mutable MCP publisher download execution is real hardening debt, but exploitation requires compromise of the protected official upstream release authority plus a maintainer release tag.

surfaces.label: Production dependencies
surfaces.notes: pnpm audit --prod reported zero known vulnerabilities across 149 production dependencies at scan time.

surfaces.label: Network behavior
surfaces.notes: The shipped runtime has no HTTP server or outbound network client; language-server communication is local stdio.

surfaces.label: Authentication and queries
surfaces.notes: Symbols has no accounts, database, hosted routes, tenant model, or query engine.
surfaces.riskArea: Authn, authz, tenant, and query injection

surfaces.label: Agent-visible text
surfaces.notes: Repository and LSP text is returned as data and is not evaluated or automatically connected to a privileged action by Symbols.

surfaces.label: Generated and developer assets
surfaces.notes: Generated reports are ignored and unshipped; playgrounds and sync/config scripts are development-only explicit maintainer surfaces.
